title: Tech Note: ACME Client Component for 4D - Part II
author: Timothy Aaron Penner, Senior Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: 4D added first-class built-in support for Let's Encrypt / automatic TLS certificate management in later 4D versions (via the 4D Server admin settings), making this hand-rolled ACME component largely unnecessary today; the underlying ACME protocol concepts remain valid, but developers would use native 4D certificate features or standard reverse-proxy/Let's Encrypt tooling (e.g., Caddy, certbot) instead.
